jason_sales: Hey team — prepping a POC for Vertex Bank. They want BYOK with HSM for Dedicated. Can we confirm a few quick things so I can reply to the RFx: 1) rotation cadence (they asked about daily rotation), 2) latency impact (keystore proxy + HSM unwrap), 3) pricing delta for BYOK/HSM vs standard hosted keys, 4) any mandatory network/firewall setup. Can @emma_se and @nina_security weigh in?

emma_se: TL;DR upfront: daily rotation is supported but needs a graceful swap plan; latency is small in-VPC, bigger cross-region; pricing varies with HSM model and throughput. Need concurrency numbers for tighter ballpark. :+1:

liam_crypto: A few notes from crypto side — customer key material can stay in their HSM (we support CloudHSM/Thales equivalence and HSM-backed KMIP). Typical pattern we recommend for daily rotation: double-wrapping + versioned key IDs + short grace window for cached tokens. This avoids downtime. Attestation/PKCS#11 flows supported.

liam_crypto: Example rotation pseudo-config we give customers (they asked for something concrete):
```json
{
  "rotation_interval_hours": 24,
  "grace_period_seconds": 300,
  "rotate_on_version": true,
  "key_uri": "cloudhsm://customer/key-id"
}
```

nina_security: Security checklist/high level: - Must enable audit logging (API calls, unwrap/verify) — retention default 1 year (can extend), - Customer-managed keys must be HSM-backed for the enterprise plan, - Require attestation docs and proof of key origin during onboarding, - For certain regulated customers we need an approved key-escrow/legal exception flow (ask legal). Also confirm they need SOC 2/FedRAMP compatibility if it's a financial customer.

cara_ops: Ops/network notes: - If Dedicated in same VPC: expect ~5–12ms extra for keystore proxy per unwrap call. - If peering across regions or through VPN: 40–120ms depending on roundtrip. - Firewall: outbound 443 to KMS endpoints (we'll provide IP ranges), allow NAT or private peering. - We'll need a dedicated subnet and IAM role for the key-proxy service. If they want HSM on-prem, that adds install windows.

jason_sales: Great — can you turn that into a one-pager / short bulleted doc to share with the customer? They also want a pricing ballpark for BYOK/HSM addon versus hosted keys (order-of-magnitude ok at first).

emma_se: I'll draft a 1-pager and a sample SOW snippet — will include: rotation pattern, expected latency, network checklist, and a sample pricing tier (e.g., +25% for entry-level HSM, +45% for high-throughput HSM). Will drop in this thread when ready.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4721 for POC environment provisioning and assigned to @cara_ops — https://infra.internal/INF-4721 :robot_face:

jason_sales: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and push back to Vertex Bank security and procurement this afternoon. If anyone has objections to the SOW wording ping me. :pray:
